title: The Architecture of Open Source Applications
author: Amy Brown, Greg Wilson (eds.)
description: Creators of two dozen significant open-source projects describe their software's architecture: why it's built the way it is, what they'd do differently, and what they learned. A rare look at real system design decisions.
